The arcsine function, denoted \(\arcsin\), returns the principal value in the interval \([-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}]\). Since \(\sin(-\frac{\pi}{6}) = -\frac{1}{2}\) and \(-\frac{\pi}{6}\) lies in this interval, we have \(\arcsin\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = -\frac{\pi}{6}\).

Answer: \(-\frac{\pi}{6}\)
